limitations: Real CUDA concurrency/speedup/VRAM feasibility not tested; parent must stop scalar and explicitly benchmark missing fits.
Physical RAM admission is a conservative heuristic; changing external demand, paging and fit-time OOM remain possible.
An unknown launch or hard-kill can require manual lease inspection; no automatic destructive recovery.
External CPU writers do not share the mutex; the original55MB reserve protects modest growth, not unlimited writes.
